title: Add --since / --before to slk read
description: Pass UNIX timestamps as oldest/latest params to conversations.history. Currently slk pulls N messages and filters client-side; this pushes the filter to Slack. Use cursor pagination with limit<=200.

title: Render files[] inline in slk read output
description: conversations.history already returns files[] per message (id, name, mimetype, url_private). Render as '[file: name (mimetype, size)]' below the message. No new API call. Scope files:read already granted.

title: Render reactions[] inline in slk read output
description: conversations.history already returns reactions[] per message ({name, count, users}). Pure rendering change in src/format.ts — append :emoji: count after the message text. No new API call. Scope reactions:read already granted.

title: Channel ID → name resolver via conversations.list cache
description: Show #general1213 instead of #C0A8A388YUF in read/search output. Call conversations.list once on first use, cache map for the session. Scopes already granted: channels:read + groups:read + im:read + mpim:read.
notes: PR opened: https://github.com/hamchowderr/slack-cli/pull/1 — feature/channel-name-cache. Awaiting review/merge before close.

title: slk watch <channel> polling stream
description: Poll conversations.history every N seconds, track last-seen ts, emit only new messages via renderMessages. Flags: -i/--interval, --limit, --once. Handle SIGINT cleanly.

title: slk send --attach <file> file upload
description: Upload files via files.getUploadURLExternal + PUT to upload URL + files.completeUploadExternal. Accept multiple --attach. Requires files:write scope.

title: slk send --thread <ts> and --reply-broadcast
description: Extend send to reply in a thread. --thread sets thread_ts. --reply-broadcast sets reply_broadcast:true (requires --thread).

title: Add slk delete command (chat.delete)
description: Delete your own messages via chat.delete. Requires --yes guard.

title: Add slk update command (chat.update)
description: Edit your own messages via chat.update. Requires --yes guard like slk send.

title: Add slk react and slk react-remove commands
description: Calls reactions.add / reactions.remove. Accepts emoji as :thumbsup: or thumbsup. Resolves channel via existing resolveTarget. Requires reactions:write scope — surface a hint if missing_scope error occurs.

title: Add --no-resolve flag to slk read
description: When set, skip <@Uxxx> -> @displayname substitution in renderMessages. Pass through raw user mentions for debugging/grep workflows.

title: Color-code Connect users in slk users output
description: When --include-connect is set, render the row in chalk.yellow for is_stranger users so they visually stand out. Don't touch JSON output.

title: slk dms --include-connect resolves external partners
description: Mirror of users --include-connect. Enrich the user cache via loadConnectUsers before listing DMs, so the 'with' column shows resolved names for Slack Connect partners instead of (unknown).

title: Add vitest smoke tests for pure functions
description: Refactor parseSlackDate from cli.ts into src/dates.ts, add tests for formatReactions, formatFile, formatBytes, parseSlackDate, channelLabel, userLabel.

title: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow
description: Run typecheck, build, and tests on every push and PR. Node 20 and Node 22 matrix on ubuntu-latest. No secrets required.

title: Add AGENTS.md with workflow guidance
description: bd doctor flagged no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md in this repo. Add a short file explaining: bd ready workflow, commit-with-bd-id convention, three-way mirror, typecheck+build before commit, no-merge rule. Link to global CLAUDE.md instead of duplicating.

title: Add LICENSE file (MIT)
description: package.json says MIT but no LICENSE file at repo root. Add MIT LICENSE, year 2026, copyright Chowderr.

title: Slack Connect external users in slk users
description: users.list does NOT include external members from shared channels. Add a flag (--include-connect?) that iterates conversations.members per shared/Connect channel and resolves each via users.info. External users carry is_stranger: true. Scope users:read already granted.

title: send command (chat.postMessage with --yes guard)
description: Implemented slk send <target> <msg>. Requires --yes flag to actually send (non-interactive; safer for agents).

title: Read commands: whoami, dms, groups, channels, users, read, thread, search
description: Implemented all read-side commands against the Slack Web API. User-token (xoxp) scopes for channels/groups/im/mpim history+read, users:read, users:read.email, search:read.

title: Initial CLI scaffold (auth, config, format helpers)
description: Built the slack-cli foundation: Commander entrypoint at src/cli.ts, fetch wrapper at src/client.ts, token resolution chain (--token / SLACK_USER_TOKEN env / Infisical) at src/config.ts, and columnify-based output formatting at src/format.ts. tsup build config, package.json with bins slk and slack-cli, npm link install.
